```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
# Add any other libraries here
library(dplyr)
library(tidymodels)

```


```{r load-data1}
# load your data 
getwd()

hd_mortalitybyca<- read.csv("data/hd_mortalitybyca.csv")

```

```{r load-data2}
hd_mortalitybyca <- hd_mortalitybyca [, c("Year", "AgeGroup", "Sex", "Diagnosis", "NumberOfDeaths", "CrudeRate", "Ca")]

hd_mortality_year <- hd_mortalitybyca %>% 
  filter(
  Year != "2024p", 
  Ca == "S92000003",
  Diagnosis == "Coronary Heart Disease",
  AgeGroup %in% c("75plus years"),
  Sex != "All") %>%
    mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year)) %>%
  arrange(Sex)

hd_mortality_year

```

```{r load-data3}
mortality_female_fit <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  fit(CrudeRate ~ Year, 
      data = hd_mortality_year %>% filter(Sex == "Female")) 

mortality_male_fit <- linear_reg() %>%
  set_engine("lm") %>%
  fit(CrudeRate ~ Year, 
      data = hd_mortality_year %>% filter(Sex == "Male")) 

mortality_male_fit
mortality_female_fit

mortality_female_aug <- augment(mortality_female_fit$fit) %>%
                                mutate(Sex = "Female")

mortality_male_aug <- augment(mortality_male_fit$fit) %>%
                                mutate(Sex = "Male")

mortality_year_fit_aug <- bind_rows(
  mortality_female_aug,
  mortality_male_aug
) %>%
  mutate(residual = ifelse(.resid >0, TRUE, FALSE))


ggplot(data = mortality_year_fit_aug) + 
 geom_point(aes(x = Year, y = CrudeRate, color = residual)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Year, y = .fitted), linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = Year,y = .fitted), color = "purple")+
  geom_segment(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = CrudeRate,
                             xend = Year, yend = .fitted), color = "purple", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Coronary Heart Disease Mortality Rates in Scotland (2015-2023)",
    subtitle = "For ages 75 years and above",
    x = "Year (2015-2023)",
    y = "Crude Rate (per 100,000 population)",
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Sex, scales = "free_y", axes = "all") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("hotpink", "forestgreen")) 
```
